description: Eight signals routed to eight outputs, with the routing shuffled at random every time a gate arrives

params.text: Sets how loudly the signal an output carried before the last shuffle is mixed in while it dies away, none at the far left and its full level at the far right

inputs.text: One of the eight signals fed into the shuffle; only a jack with a cable in it takes part
Shuffles the routing on each rising edge, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Adds to the FADE knob, 1V covering the whole of its travel

outputs.text: Carries whichever input the shuffle has routed here, with the fading tail of the one it carried before mixed in; before any shuffle it carries the input of the same number

notes: no output is written at all until at least one of the eight inputs has a cable in it
only inputs with a cable are shuffled, so patching three of the eight rotates those three among the outputs of the same three numbers and leaves the other five alone

inputs.8:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.9:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
